evidence: GADM 4.1 files the Peñón de Vélez de la Gomera (ESP.7.1.1.3_1) under Ceuta (ESP.7.1_1). The register's area penon-de-velez-de-la-gomera is a paper_claim with garrison only (data/disputed-areas, held by Spain as a plaza de soberanía; Morocco claims it), so by R051 (2) it is a special place whose land goes with its holder, Spain, under every point of view (TYR's O1, confirmed 2026-11-24); inside area/ceuta it would follow Morocco's view of Ceuta. Ceuta keeps the city (ESP.7.1.1.1_1) and Isla del Perejil (ESP.7.1.1.2_1), whose register kind own_regime is open under Q016; the Peñón falls to ES.

GADM 4.1 files the Chafarinas Islands (ESP.7.2.1.1_1) and the Peñón de Alhucemas (ESP.7.2.1.3_1) under Melilla (ESP.7.2_1). The register's areas islas-chafarinas and penon-de-alhucemas are paper_claims with garrison only (Spain administers, Morocco claims), so by R051 (2) they are special places whose land goes with their holder, Spain, under every point of view (TYR's O1, confirmed 2026-11-24); inside area/melilla they would follow Morocco's view of Melilla. Melilla keeps the city (ESP.7.2.1.2_1); both fall to ES.
